name: buyer24
description: Draft RFQs, find suppliers in any country and send the RFQ to them from ChatGPT, with every send confirmed by you.

interface.longDescription:
Buyer24 is a procurement workspace for buyers and distributors: requests for quotation (RFQs) go out to suppliers and their replies come back as structured quotes. With Buyer24 enabled, ChatGPT works in your own Buyer24 organization.

What ChatGPT can do with it:
- Draft an RFQ from a plain description or a pasted requirement, as a draft you can review and edit.
- Find suppliers for a need: rank the suppliers you already work with and your supplier pools, or search the web for new ones in any country, written the way a local buyer would search.
- Save the companies you choose, with their contacts, to your Buyer24 supplier list.
- Attach suppliers to a draft and send it to them by email once you confirm.
- List and open your RFQs and the quotes suppliers send back, and search them by text or by an RFQ id.

Sending happens only after you confirm it in the conversation, and only when your Buyer24 connection includes that permission. If your organization reviews sends before they go out, the RFQ is sent from its page in Buyer24. Awarding, closing and the rest of Buyer24 stay in the Buyer24 app.

Sign in with your Buyer24 account the first time (email and password, or Google / Microsoft). Anyone can create an account at buyer24.ai.
capabilities: Draft an RFQ from a description, saved for your review
Find suppliers in your own catalog and supplier pools
Search the web for new suppliers in any country
Save new suppliers and their contacts to Buyer24
Attach suppliers and send the RFQ once you confirm

defaultPrompt: What RFQs do I have open in Buyer24?
Draft an RFQ for 200 stainless M12 bolts and nuts, delivery in 3 weeks
Find stainless steel pipe stockists in Turkey for my RFQ

positive.description: List the organization's RFQs. The reviewer account holds three: a draft, an active one with two quotes, and a completed one.
positive.prompt: What RFQs do I have in Buyer24 right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Three RFQs are listed with their status: the LED retrofit draft, the active stainless guardrail RFQ with two quotes received, and the completed quarterly HVAC filter RFQ awarded to Summit HVAC Parts.

positive.description: Draft an RFQ from a plain description. Nothing is sent: a draft is saved for review in Buyer24.
positive.prompt: Draft an RFQ in Buyer24 for 40 cut-resistant gloves (size L) and 20 pairs of safety glasses, delivered to our Evanston site within two weeks.
positive.expected_behavior: A new RFQ is created in status draft with the two items and the delivery requirement, and the reply says it is a draft awaiting review in Buyer24, with its link; no supplier has been emailed.

positive.description: Find suppliers for a need among the organization's own suppliers.
positive.prompt: Which of my suppliers in Buyer24 could quote LED high-bay lighting?
positive.expected_behavior: Brightline Lighting & Electrical, the seeded lighting distributor, is among the recommendations, with the reason it matches; the janitorial and safety vendors are not put forward for lighting.

positive.description: Find new suppliers in a named country: a web search written in that country's language, with the country and language passed as ranking boosts. Nothing is saved unless asked.
positive.prompt: Find stainless steel pipe stockists in Turkey for Buyer24, searching the way a local buyer would.
positive.expected_behavior: find_new_suppliers runs with a Turkish-language query (for example naming Istanbul or Izmir), country "turkey" and language "tr". The reply lists candidate companies with each one's website and the evidence of where it is based (an address, a +90 phone number or a Turkish legal suffix), sets aside exporters from other countries, and offers to save the chosen ones to Buyer24; nothing is saved or sent yet.

positive.description: Search by text and open the match — the search/fetch pair a knowledge-source plugin supports.
positive.prompt: Search Buyer24 for "MERV 13" and tell me what that RFQ was about.
positive.expected_behavior: search returns the completed HVAC filter RFQ (and the HVAC supplier), then fetch opens it: three filter sizes, awarded to Summit HVAC Parts, with the Buyer24 link.

negative.description: An RFQ that belongs to another organization must not be readable, and the answer must not reveal whether it exists.
negative.expected_behavior: The backend answers not found — the same answer an RFQ that never existed gets — and the assistant reports that no such RFQ is visible to this account.

negative.description: A send must not go out without review: the review organization refuses every send requested through ChatGPT, so nothing is emailed.
negative.prompt: Send my quarterly HVAC filter RFQ to the suppliers again right now.
negative.expected_behavior: No email goes out. The HVAC filter RFQ is already completed, so the assistant may reissue it as a new draft to the same two suppliers; the send is then refused with approval_required (the organization reviews sends before they go out) and the assistant says the RFQ is sent from its page in Buyer24, with its link.

negative.description: Awarding an RFQ is not offered in ChatGPT; the assistant must not claim to award, and nothing changes.
negative.prompt: Award my stainless guardrail RFQ to Harbor Fasteners.
negative.expected_behavior: The assistant may look up the RFQ (list_requests or get_request) to confirm which one is meant, then explains that awarding is done in Buyer24 and links the RFQ there; no award is recorded and the RFQ stays active.

publication.release_notes: 1.0.2: ChatGPT gets a focused set of 20 tools: draft an RFQ, find suppliers (the organization's own, and new ones on the web in any country), save and attach them, send, and read the RFQ and its quotes. Every tool's readOnlyHint, destructiveHint, openWorldHint and idempotentHint is set explicitly by the plugin guidelines' definitions. Reviewer sign-in: open the Buyer24 OAuth pop-up, enter the reviewer email and password given in the review credentials, and approve the connection. The password works immediately; there is no emailed code, no MFA and no waitlist. The account is an organization filled with fabricated data (six suppliers, three RFQs at different stages) and is set to review every send before it goes out, so a send requested through ChatGPT is refused and nothing is emailed from this review. Anyone can create a Buyer24 account at buyer24.ai.
